source: Patient First mandatory disclosure page (WordPress API JSON)
export_description: EHI Export functionality allows health systems to do a manual one-time export of health data. The export contains the electronic health information available in a patient’s record in a computable file format. Some electronic health information might not be available in a computable format, such as PDF documents or images. The actual files can be reviewed in the export. The export file will consist of a compressed (zip) archive with the following information:

categories.description: Medical records in industry-standard C-CDA format

categories.folder_name: Scan, with a sub folder per type of document (i.e. InsCard, PhotoID)

categories.description: Secure Messages sent to and from the patient
Various forms, such a Drug Screen results

notes: No data dictionary or schema is provided for any export category.
No sample export files are provided.
No field-level documentation exists for any category.
The 'Medical Records' category uses C-CDA, which is a standard with external specs.
The 'Financials' category uses JSON with no schema or field definitions documented.
The 'Scanned Images' folder has subfolders per document type (e.g., InsCard, PhotoID).
RWT Measure #3 labels b(10) metric as 'Number of C-CDA Batch Exports Sent', conflating EHI export with C-CDA batch export.
